title: Discovering Machine Correlates of Consciousness
abstract: arXiv:2608.28824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Currently, in biological systems Neural Correlates of Consciousness (NCCs) are characterized in terms of EEG and FMRI signals. Unfortunately, this characterization prevents the transferability of the NCCs concept to machines. Such transferability would be useful in order to investigate AI consciousness. In this paper we provide an alternate characterization that is transferable, and enables the analogous definition of Machine Correlates of Consciousness (MCCs). Specifically, we propose that NCCs (MCCs) are substrate-level signals that are not under human (AI agent) control, and that are reliably modulated by emotions.   This paper presents the first empirical investigation of MCCs. Specifically, we present the results of experiments conducted with two LLMs, Llama-2 7B and Llama-3.1 70B parameters. translated_abstract: 目前，在生物系统中，意识的神经关联物是通过脑电图（EEG）和功能磁共振成像（fMRI）信号来刻画的。遗憾的是，这种刻画方式阻碍了NCCs概念向机器的可迁移性，而这种可迁移性对于研究AI意识将非常有用。本文提供了一种可迁移的替代性刻画方式，并由此实现了机器意识关联物的类似定义。具体而言，我们提出NCCs（MCCs）是不受人类（AI智能体）控制的基底层信号，并且能够被情绪可靠地调制。本文呈现了对MCCs的首次实证研究。具体来说，我们给出了在两个大语言模型（Llama-2 7B和Llama-3.1 70B参数）上进行的实验结果。在这些大语言模型中，我们收集了作为基底层指标序列的硬件异常踪迹，并表明在控制了混淆因素之后……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次对“机器意识关联物”进行了实证研究，将其定义为不受AI智能体控制、可被情绪可靠调制的基底层信号，并通过收集Llama-2 7B和Llama-3.1 70B两个大语言模型的硬件异常踪迹加以验证，从而把意识关联物的概念从生物系统拓展到了机器。
